body:
@Haroenv thanks for your fast follow up. Setting `esModuleInterop: true` resolves this error but opens up many other issues. I haven't been able to reproduce the problem in a minimal example yet, so I'm diving more deeply (I haven't worked with typescript in a few years). 

Hopefully I can get you something to work with soon. In my big baggy repo I get:

```
yarn run v1.22.17
$ tsc
pnode_modules/instantsearch.js/es/lib/InstantSearch.d.ts:94:97 - error TS2507: Type 'typeof EventEmitter' is not a constructor function type.

94 declare class InstantSearch<TUiState extends UiState = UiState, TRouteState = TUiState> extends EventEmitter {
                                                                                                   ~~~~~~~~~~~~
Found 1 error.

error Command failed with exit code 2.
```

In my environment, changing `import EventEmitter from 'events';` to `import { EventEmitter } from 'events'` resolves the issue. Can someone help me understand why `events` is showing unpredictable behavior here?
